episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the importance of building a personal brand independent of brokerage identity, especially in light of recent mergers and acquisitions in the real estate industry. He emphasizes the need for agents to improve their AI visibility through diverse content creation and offers actionable strategies to achieve this, such as publishing on authoritative websites and creating a personalized voice guide for AI content.
